description: Free compatibility preview for two people: saves both charts in the connected Celestio account and returns the strongest connections between them.

first.description: The first person: birth details or a chartId

chartId.description: A chartId returned by an earlier Celestio tool

person.description: Birth details, when there is no chartId yet

latitude.description: Optional: exact latitude; with longitude and timeZone it overrides the place search

place.description: Birth place as "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Sofia, Bulgaria"

time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour ("14:30") or 12-hour ("2:30 PM", "2:30 p.m.", "2pm"). Leave out when unknown: the chart then has no rising sign or houses
